name: Prime Address
summary: Turn an avenue lot into a Class A office address.
briefing: Highveld pays the best rents on the continent, but it only rents to the best buildings. Building is dear and tax is high. Reach Class A with a reputation of 70 within 40 days.

events.message: Exchange Avenue: the city's brokers are watching your lot.
The avenue board inspects the frontage: reputation 50 expected
